notes: Seeded per TACR category index i, the same rule baiw.json uses:
current = 1 + 0.5i,  desired = min(5, current + [0.5, 1.2, 1.8, 2.5][i % 4]),
gap = desired - current.
overallScore is src/scoring/maturity.ts::overallCurrent — the mean of the
SCORED categories, one decimal. 22 / 8 = 2.75 -> 2.8.
answeredCategories === totalCategories so isDraft is false.
THE NINTH CATEGORY IS GONE (D4 closing item). This block carried a ninth row,
"Overall Assessment" (5 / 5 / 0), which tacrQuestions.json does not contain and
TradeMaturityAssessment.tsx has never supplied — it builds `categories` from
that dataset and passes `totalCategories: categories.length`, which is 8. So
the baseline described a document production cannot generate, and every TAIW
assertion measured against it — page counts, table rows, right-edge extents,
the D-002 fix, three migration walks — was measured against a shape with one
axis, one scorecard row and three markdown bullets that do not exist.
It also moved the headline: 27 / 9 = 3.0 became 22 / 8 = 2.8, because the
fabricated row was a perfect 5.0 and was averaged in like a real one.
The generator still defines a ninth CATEGORIES entry, and still excludes it
from the deep dives (CATEGORIES.length - 1) and the benchmark table
(CATEGORIES.slice(0, 8)) — that is source, not fixture, and unchanged here.
engagementId/generatedAt/layer were added in D2 step 2, for the same reason
they were added to haiw.json in step 1: the PDF and the markdown now take a
ReportMeta, and a clock-derived date would make them un-reproducible from
one day to the next. The gap CSV reads none of the three - its baseline is
unaffected, and that is checked rather than assumed.
assessmentPartial (D4) — the FIRST artefact in this repo that exercises an
unanswered category. Four of eight TACR categories answered; the fourth
("Information & Integration") only halfway, so the within-category unanswered
path is covered as well as the whole-category one. Derived from the same rule
src/scoring/maturity.ts applies, not hand-typed: overall is the mean of the
SCORED categories' UNROUNDED means. `scores` carries only the scored four —
an unscored category has no number to put on a scorecard row.
Answered 282 of 640 questions;
overall 3 from 4 of 8 categories.
Under the pre-D4 rule (divide by all 8) the same answers put
1.5 on the cover.
dataSources, D5 stage E1. Two directions here, and they are different facts.
capabilities.json and dataRequirements.json ARE imported by
tradeReportGenerator.ts while the `data` block freezes only benchmarks.json,
so both were read LIVE at capture with no fingerprint covering them - D-010,
found by FINGERPRINT-COVERAGE. crosswalk.json was NOT read by a generator
when E1 declared it; it was declared ahead of D5 stage E3, which puts a
framework scorecard in the report. Declaring first means the fingerprint is
correct on the commit that starts reading it, instead of one stage later -
which is exactly how frameworks.json slipped out from under DGIW's
fingerprint in stage B. Declaring does NOT freeze: only `data` keys are
served, so bytes are unchanged.
E3 CONFIRMED THE DECLARATION WORKS RATHER THAN ASSUMING IT. Removing this
line once E3's generators existed made FINGERPRINT-COVERAGE fail by name,
naming the file, the import chain and this fixture. A pre-emptive
declaration nobody has watched fail is a declaration nobody has proven.
tacrSpine / tacrAnswers / tacrAnswersPartial, D5 stage E3. The framework
projection buckets by TACR SECTION, which is finer than the category means
`assessment` above already aggregates - so it needs the question-level
answers and the tree that says which section each question belongs to.
tacrSpine carries ids and the two names ONLY: the projection derives a
section id from a question id and renders `category / section`, and never
reads question text, levels or guidance. Freezing those would be freezing
500 kB of what nothing reads.
tacrQuestions.json is therefore in dataSources - the frozen tree came from
it, so a question inserted upstream must show as `source datasets` drift
rather than silently leaving the spine one section short.
SEED: currentState = 1 + (k % 5), desiredState = min(5, currentState + 1 +
(k % 3)), k the question's index in file order. Identical to haiw.json's.
tacrAnswersPartial answers four of the eight categories with the fourth
("Information & Integration") only halfway - 282 of 640, the same coverage
assessmentPartial describes. It is the ONLY input that reaches three of the
alignment pack's sections: not-assessed leaf dimensions, dimensions scored
from part of their evidence, and a scoredShare below retainedShare. On the
full set every mapped dimension is 100% scored and those three render empty,
which is the shape CLAUDE.md warns about - at 8-of-8 every rule coincides.
frameworks.json, D5 stage E3 - the THIRD instance of the D-010 shape this
check has caught, and the one the pre-emptive declaration above did not
anticipate. SHARED_DATASETS in fingerprint-decl.mjs covers frameworks.json
for DGIW only, because until E3 only DGIW's generators read it. TAIW's new
framework alignment pack and scorecard reach it through
src/taiw/projection.ts, so a DMBOK2 or COBIT dimension-weight edit would
have moved every figure on both documents while `source datasets` printed
stable. Declared per fixture rather than promoted into SHARED_DATASETS: that
constant is DGIW's directory-hash supplement and means something different.
